snippet.title: The Dreams in the Peacock House - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Explore the Peacock House, find the mystic eyes, and unlock the Sanctum Sanctorum in this short narrative experience blending elements of classic text adventures, visual novels, and point-and-click games.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4693460/The_Dreams_in_the_Peacock_House/
